title: Tasks
agUiHelp: Share recorded task state with compatible in-app clients. Task controls and approvals use the same local controller.
intro: Plan bounded work and inspect its recorded progress. Validated tasks still require integration review.

connection.reconnecting: Reconnecting — displayed state may be stale

scopeHelp: Enter one relative file or folder path per line. Leave empty for read-only work.
required: Project, plan title, and each task title are required
empty: No tasks in this plan. Create a plan to begin.
integrationNotice: Artifact validation records task evidence. Applying changes to your branch is a separate review step.
select: Select a task to inspect attempts and evidence.
annotationFolderIntro: Screenshots and notes are saved together in this folder. Changing it leaves existing logs in place.
annotationIntro: Keep edits, quick memory notes and screenshots at the point they were recorded. This log stays on your computer.
annotationFolderHint: Choose your Debugging logs / Radium Production log folder here or in General settings. Existing entries stay in their original folder.
annotationImported: Attached image — original capture time is unknown
annotationEmpty: No annotations in this folder yet.
annotationRecent: Showing the latest 50 entries. Older entries remain in the log folder.
